title: World Bank second Additional Financing (US$50m) to CAR Emergency Food Crisis Response Project
description: World Bank IDA Crisis Response Window – Early Response Financing grant of US$50 million (SDR 36.5 million) as a second Additional Financing to the Central African Republic Emergency Food Crisis Response Project (P176754), bringing total CRW-ERF support for the project to US$150 million. Scales emergency cash-for-work, food/livelihood support and resilience-building; extends geographic coverage from 12 to 16 of CAR's 20 prefectures; and finances consolidation and cross-checking of beneficiary registration databases (with the National Statistical Institute, ICASEES providing technical support) against existing registries, with a stated biometric-data risk assessment and data-management protocol.

title: Greenline Technologies — Central African Republic SOCATEL digital hub, 2025
description: "Greenline Technologies Inc. has been awarded the mandate to privatize, revitalize, and transform SOCATEL, the national telecom operator of CAR... The signing of the Memorandum of Understanding marks a turning point... The agreement lays the foundation for building a national digital hub at the heart of Africa, complete with a new Tier 3 data center and a modern connectivity ecosystem." "With an initial investment of $150 million, the project aims to: Position the Central African Republic as a regional leader in digital transformation... Establish advanced digital services and cybersecurity frameworks. Expand CAR's national telecom infrastructure."
recipient_organisation: SOCATEL / Government of the Central African Republic
